simplesect.para: this->Inst && this->Origin are valid Instructions and this object passed the legal check: LoadedSlice::isLegal returned true.

briefdescription.para: Check if this slice can be merged with an expensive cross register bank copy.

briefdescription.para: Helper structure used to slice a load in smaller loads.

detaileddescription.para: Basically a slice is obtained from the following sequence: Origin = load Ty1, Base Shift = srl Ty1 Origin, CstTy Amount Inst = trunc Shift to Ty2
Then, it will be rewritten into: Slice = load SliceTy, Base + SliceOffset [Inst = zext Slice to Ty2], only if SliceTy <> Ty2
SliceTy is deduced from the number of bits that are actually used to build Inst.
